row:
Award winning Registered Massage Therapist bringing you Health and Wellness tips in the form of self care.
Leave a comment to request stretches for specific concerns & Subscribe to be notified of when those stretch and mobility videos are released!

Fellow massage therapists are also welcome to subscribe & watch my Championship-winning massage footage & massage technique demonstrations. I won the 2026 Gold Medal in Sports Massage and the 2025 Bronze Medal in Swedish Massage at the Canadian Massage Championship.

I will be competing in the 2026 World Massage Championship (Copenhagen, Denmark) and 2026 American Massage Championship (Cherokee, North Carolina, US).

Feel free to leave comments requesting any more footage/demonstrations of my techniques that you would like to see more of! :)
